text.p: (Thousands of dollars except per share amounts)
For the Three Months For the Six Months
Included in the quarterly results for 1997 is $1,658,000, or $0.11 per common share, of net after-tax gains related to dispositions of oil and gas related interests.
After preferred stock dividends for the six months ended

On January 17, 1996, the Company issued 2,113,557 shares of Common Stock upon conversion of 1,115,988 shares of its l,150,000 outstanding shares of $2.3125 Convertible Exchangeable Preferred Stock. In addition, the Company issued 1,200,000 shares of its Common Stock on May 23, 1996 in connection with the acquisition of 9 jack-up drilling rigs and a 50% interest in a joint venture which owns an additional jack-up drilling rig. On June 9, 1997, the Company effected a 2 for 1 stock split in the form of a 100% stock dividend to holders of record on May 22, 1997.
